name: Sultan Mosque
summary: One generous dome, two slender minarets, and one open doorway form a single grounded mosque.
why: The dome and doorway share x=54. Mirrored minarets have identical caps and shafts, and all walls meet the y=74 foundation. The brass cornice is attached to the hall and matches the two shaft collars.
risk: This is the most familiar of the three. Its identity comes from graceful proportions rather than an unusual secondary symbol.
sub1: Every wall belongs to one mosque
reasonToChoose: You want a mosque that feels complete, timeless, and immediately recognizable.
